aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparison evidence but the changed factor and outcome grouping are not yet reliable.
issues: Changed factor is a filename instead of the plasma machine/setting condition.
Baseline and changed conditions are explicit but left unresolved.
Setting MC plasma is treated as an outcome rather than process-condition evidence.
Row 14 alone does not support the generated setting statistics.
Row 26 is cited but not included in provided context rows.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to CD plasma machine/setting comparison for CD+VP tension.
Set conditions as C2, E2 normal, and E2 after MC setting same as C2.
Use tension rows 26-28 as the primary measurement outcome.
Move Setting MC plasma values to changed-factor evidence or cite rows containing the actual settings.
Remove filename-based factor text and vague baseline/test labels.
